close_reason: Fixed in PR #96: tracing test modules attach global named telemetry handlers; concurrent async tests emitting matching events crash the handler and telemetry auto-detaches it. Marked all four tracing test modules async: false.
description: test/bedrock/data_plane/log/tracing_test.exs is async: true but start/0-stop/0 manipulate a GLOBAL named telemetry handler; concurrent modules touching the same handler make stop return {:error, :not_found} mid-test. Failed PR #91 and #92 CI on the new Elixir 1.20.2 matrix cell. Fix: async: false (or a unique handler id per test if the API allows). Related flake: bedrock-y6e (directory property stub).

comments.text: Third ghost flake identified and fixed on the same PR #96: olivine genserver_integration_test called GenServer.call(pid, {:info,:kind}, 1) unwrapped — a 1ms timeout EXITS the caller under load. This was the unattributable single-run full-suite failure seen ~4 times across agent runs.

title: Flaky test: Log.TracingTest races global telemetry handler under async: true
